changes.summary: Retained-power time after ignition off goes from 45 s to 60 s. The door-open cut-off is unchanged. This takes over the deleted WLC-023, which said 60 s and contradicted the old 45 s.

Fully rewritten. The vague 'close quickly on rain' is replaced by: on the CAN request WLC_CloseAll from the body controller, close in express mode with anti-pinch active. The trigger, the source and the closing mode are all new; the rain sensor is no longer mentioned.
Pinch detection force threshold lowered from 100 N to 80 N.
Minimum reversal distance after a pinch goes from 125 mm to 150 mm (or to fully open, whichever is less). The 10 ms stop time is unchanged.
'set itself to not normalized' becomes 'set its state to not normalized'. The 500 ms threshold and the behaviour are unchanged.
Undefined limit and 'safe value' replaced by numbers: when the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, motor current is limited to 15 A. 'Reduce' becomes 'limit'.
WLC_Status cycle time changes from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. The content (four signals) is unchanged.

Split. WLC-030 now only requires storing B1A02 (above 25 A for more than 50 ms). Stopping the motor and setting the fault state move to the new WLC-037 and WLC-038. Their trigger is now 'when B1A02 is stored', not the overcurrent event itself. Read as a state, that could stop the motor whenever the DTC is still stored, for example after an ignition cycle, so the meaning may have changed.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-023; trace to WLC-007 only. Procedure: switch ignition off; press the switch at 55 s and at 65 s; repeat with a front door opened at 10 s and the switch pressed at 15 s. Pass: movement at 55 s; no movement at 65 s; no movement after the door is opened.
tests.reason: The time limit moved from 45 s to 60 s, so the 40 s/50 s check points no longer bracket the limit, and the trace to deleted WLC-023 must go.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Retitle to 'Close on WLC_CloseAll'. Procedure: with the window half open and no switch pressed, send the CAN request WLC_CloseAll; repeat with the pinch rod in the pinch zone. Pass: the window closes to fully closed in express mode without any switch input; with the rod, a pinch is detected when the force exceeds 80 N, the motor stops within 10 ms and the window reverses by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: The trigger changed from a rain signal to a CAN request, and the requirement now needs express mode and active anti-pinch, which the old procedure and pass criteria do not check.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Pinch detected when the pinch force exceeds 80 N (and not before); motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: Both limits it checks changed (100 N to 80 N, 125 mm to 150 mm).

tests.new_pass_criteria: As the updated TC-AP-01 at 9.0 V: detection when the force exceeds 80 N, stop within 10 ms, reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: It inherits its pass criteria from TC-AP-01, whose limits changed.

tests.new_pass_criteria: As the updated TC-AP-01 at 16.0 V: detection when the force exceeds 80 N, stop within 10 ms, reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: It inherits its pass criteria from TC-AP-01, whose limits changed.

tests.new_pass_criteria: As the updated TC-AP-01 at 9.0 V and -30 °C: detection when the force exceeds 80 N, stop within 10 ms, reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: Its limits changed, and per LL-2022-02 this cold, low-voltage corner is the worst case for stop time and must be run on every software release.

tests.new_pass_criteria: As the updated TC-AP-01 at 13.5 V and 85 °C: detection when the force exceeds 80 N, stop within 10 ms, reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: It inherits its pass criteria from TC-AP-01, whose limits changed.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-018 and retrace to WLC-014 and WLC-015. Pass: over the whole rough-road vibration profile with no obstacle, no pinch is detected and no reversal happens; with the pinch rod under the same vibration, a pinch is detected when the force exceeds 80 N and the motor stops within 10 ms.
tests.reason: Its only requirement is deleted, but LL-2021-07 says a lower force threshold must be rechecked for false reversals and stop time, so the test must be kept and retraced, not retired.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Unchanged: normalized after a 400 ms interruption; not normalized after a 600 ms interruption.
tests.reason: The WLC-021 change is wording only, and the 500 ms threshold and behaviour are the same.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Run open-close cycles until the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, logging the estimated temperature and the motor current. Pass: once the estimate exceeds 130 °C, motor current does not exceed 15 A; no limiting while the estimate is at or below 130 °C.
tests.reason: The limit and the reaction are now numeric (130 °C, 15 A), so the old 'current reduced' check is no longer specific enough.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Record WLC_Status for 10 s while moving the window, both on a quiet bus and at worst-case bus load including an active diagnostic session. Pass: every period is within 50 ms ± 5 ms; window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state are present in every frame.
tests.reason: The cycle time halved, and LL-2024-09 requires checking under worst-case bus load when the cycle gets shorter.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Trace to WLC-030, WLC-037 and WLC-038. Inject 27 A for 100 ms with the window blocked. Pass: B1A02 stored; motor stopped; fault state set in WLC_Status. Negative case: inject 27 A for 40 ms; B1A02 is not stored.
tests.reason: The requirement was split, so the traces must cover WLC-037/038. The 50 ms debounce in WLC-030 now stands alone and should get a negative check.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Remove the trace to WLC-032; keep the trace to WLC-004. Pass criteria must come from the sleep-current limit in WLC-004 (check that WLC-004 states one); extend the wait before measuring so it is clearly after the 60 s retained-power period and sleep entry.
tests.reason: WLC-032 is deleted, but sleep current is still needed under WLC-004.
Its only requirement, WLC-033, is deleted and was not verifiable, so the review no longer verifies any requirement.

added.pass_criteria: After 27 A for 100 ms stores B1A02, the motor is stopped and does not run while B1A02 is stored. After the DTC is cleared, normal movement is possible again. Also check the behaviour after an ignition cycle with B1A02 still stored, once the event-versus-state meaning is clarified.
When B1A02 is stored, the fault state signal in WLC_Status is set in the next WLC_Status frame (50 ms ± 5 ms cycle) and stays set while B1A02 is stored.

added.extend_test: TC-AP-08 (or a new test TC-AP-10 if TC-AP-08's lockout sequence would be disturbed)
added.pass_criteria: After a pinch reversal: a short close press, and a WLC_CloseAll request, sent 1.8 s after the reversal do not start express close. The same inputs sent 2.2 s after the reversal start express close. The reference point (reversal start or end) and the tolerance must be clarified first, and whether manual close is allowed during the 2 s.

concerns.concern: Not traced to a changed requirement, but it checks pinch protection in manual and express mode, so it relies on the 80 N threshold and 150 mm reversal. Its pass criteria must be updated and it must be rerun.
Repeated-pinch lockout depends on how pinches are detected and reversed (80 N, 150 mm) and now interacts with the new 2 s express-close inhibit (WLC-039). Rerun it.
LL-2022-02: run cold plus low voltage on every software release, not just for this change. A lower threshold and a longer reversal increase timing pressure.

LL-2021-07: lowering the threshold to 80 N increases the risk of false reversals on rough roads. Deleting WLC-018 leaves no requirement for disturbance robustness at all. Ask for a measurable replacement requirement instead of losing the coverage.

Is dropping the rain-sensor close intended, or does it now come in through WLC_CloseAll from the body controller? Also, WLC-012 demands express mode with anti-pinch active, but TC-MV-08/WLC-013 allow express only when normalized and TC-AP-07/WLC-017 switch anti-pinch off when not normalized. The spec must say what WLC_CloseAll does when the window is not normalized, and whether the WLC-039 inhibit applies to it.
Rerun it, and extend it to WLC_CloseAll (express close requested over CAN when not normalized).

The procedure waits only 60 s before measuring, which now equals the retained-power time in WLC-007. The controller may not be asleep yet, so lengthen the wait. Also confirm that WLC-004 carries a numeric sleep-current limit now that WLC-032 is gone. The 50 ms CAN cycle could also delay sleep entry.

WLC-025 now uses a fixed 130 °C limit on the estimated temperature, so thermal model accuracy is critical. LL-2024-01: check that the estimate is up to date when the limit is checked, and that the fix in the platform thermal module shared with WLC-200 is in this build. No reaction time is given for limiting to 15 A, so ask for one.
TC-TH-03 and TC-TH-04 use the same thermal estimate and may assume the same limit. Check them against the 130 °C value and rerun.
LL-2024-09: with the cycle cut to 50 ms, repeat the worst-case CAN transmit-queue and bus-load calculation, and test during diagnostic sessions.
Diagnostic response time and fault reporting depend on the WLC_Status cycle and on bus load, which change with the 50 ms cycle. Rerun it under worst-case load.

WLC-037/038 say 'when B1A02 is stored'. This can be read as a lasting state, so the motor would stay blocked across ignition cycles until the DTC is cleared. The old text was about the event. Get this clarified before finalising the pass criteria.
Not affected by the change, but LL-2023-05 requires removing the Hall sensor while the motor runs, at the lowest supply voltage, with a plausibility timeout. Check that TC-DG-01 actually does this.

WLC-033 was untestable, and WLC-034 was a process requirement with no test. Deleting both is right; keep the usability review as an informal design activity outside requirement verification if the program values it.

added.WLC-039: After a pinch reversal, express close shall be inhibited for 2 s.
added.WLC-037: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall stop the motor.
added.WLC-038: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

deleted.WLC-018: The anti-pinch function shall be robust against all disturbances.
deleted.WLC-023: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s.
deleted.WLC-032: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
deleted.WLC-033: The controller shall be user friendly.
deleted.WLC-034: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.

WLC-007.old: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.
WLC-007.new: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.

WLC-012.old: The window shall close quickly when the rain sensor reports rain.
WLC-012.new: When the body controller sends the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, the controller shall close the window in express mode, with anti-pinch protection active.

WLC-014.old: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 100 N.
WLC-014.new: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N.

WLC-015.old: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 125 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
WLC-015.new: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.

WLC-021.old: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set itself to not normalized.
WLC-021.new: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set its state to not normalized.

WLC-025.old: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value.
WLC-025.new: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, the controller shall limit motor current to 15 A.

WLC-028.old: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 100 ms ± 10 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
WLC-028.new: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 50 ms ± 5 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

WLC-030.old: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.
WLC-030.new: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms.
